newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil hits contract lows, soymeal also down.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil hits contract lows, soymeal also down.

text.p: CBOT new crop soyoil futures touched contract lows and soymeal also opened lower on Monday, shadowing losses in soybeans tied to weekend rainfall in central Illinois, traders said.

Meteorologists said rain fell across roughly half of central Illinois by early Monday, easing concerns of heat and moisture stress. Forecasts called for more rains through Tuesday with 60 to 80 percent coverage.
At 0955 CDT, soymeal was down $4.70 to $3.40 per ton with October down $3.70 at $198.00. Soyoil was off 0.43 to 0.33 cent per lb with October down 0.37 at 22.03.
Contract lows were notched in the September and October soyoil contracts. The new low for October is 21.72 cents per lb. The previous low of 21.76 was hit on July 1.
